notes.title: FALL '25 UPDATE (Early Access v6)
notes.notes:
[b][u]BUGS FIXED[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed wall slide animation sometimes not triggering when sliding downward
[/list]

[b][u]ADDITIONS/CHANGES[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed ground movement feeling too rigid and heavy when quickly switching directions
[*] Improved camera behavior when colliding with walls
[*] New collision added between the ball and the weapon when charging a strike, allowing better forward control and dribbling
[*] Automatic cross-platform key glyphs (icons adapt to your input device)
[*] Custom key mappings are now saved locally, no need to remap each time you play
[*] Added sensitivity settings for mouse and joystick camera control
[*] Added camera FOV setting 
[*] Various small visual improvements
[/list]

Thanks again for all your feedback, it really helps us shape the game!
Keep sharing your ideas and bug reports on the Discord — we can’t wait to see what you think of these tweaks and new options. 🙂

notes.title: SPRING '25 UPDATE (Early Access v5)
notes.notes:
[u][b]BUGS FIXED[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Reaching a corner during a wallrun made the character stuck, you can now wall jump to get out of the situation
[*] Checkpoint gates didn't always detect that a character had passed through
[*] "Dash" entry was missing in the control mapper
[*] "Switch Role" sound was playing on loop while waiting for match start
[*] Personal best time was incorrectly displayed in solo mode levels UI
[/list]


[u][b]ADDITIONS/CHANGES[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Solo mode [b]WORLD 2[/b] added, with 9 new levels! 
[*] Added [b]leaderboards[/b] for each solo mode level, let the battles for all 18 levels best time begin!
[*] [b]Personal best time ghost[/b] added, making it easier to improve on your times (the runs replayed by the ghost are those done after this update, you need to complete the level at least once to see it) 
[*] "Low" graphic setting now reduce screen render scale and shadows quality, making it even faster
[*] "Ultra" quality setting added (better anti-aliasing, shadows and lighting quality) 
[*] Level and world indexes now diplayed while playing in solo mode
[*] You can now emote while waiting for match start
[*] Quick match waiting time reduced to 30s
[/list]

[i]Can't wait to hear your thoughts on these changes! 

If you find any bugs or have suggestions for the next update, feel free to share them on the Discord server! :)[/i]

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE 4
notes.notes:
[b][u]BUGS FIXED[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Mouse input no longer disabled in pause menu
[*] Fixed an issue where team role UI (attack/neutral/defense) wouldn’t update for non-master clients in online matches.
[*] Pressing "Enter" while typing the Match Code no longer adds an extra newline character.
[/list]

[u][b]ADDITIONS/CHANGES[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Added input mapper menu (keys binder) for controller and keyboard+mouse 
[*] Reworked dash behaviour on walls
[*] Dash without joystick direction now makes the player fall fast (easier to get back to the ground) 
[*] Jumping near the edge of a wall triggers "auto wall pass", making it easier to climb above walls. 
[*] Added keyboard hints for private match start screen 
[/list]

Let me know what you think of these changes!

Things are quite busy for me right now, as I'm currently juggling a lot of other work, so progress is a bit slow, unfortunately. 
However, things should pick up in the next few weeks. I'm still listening to your feedback and working on improving the game, step by step.

If you find any bugs or have suggestions for the next update, feel free to share them on the Discord server! :)

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE 3
notes.notes:
[b][u]BUGS FIXED[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Various bugs occuring on players spawn in online matches
[*] Various bugs occuring on bot players
[*] Player "Ready" state not sync properly in private online match
[*] Countdown text not uploading on all players in public online match
[*] Always displaying loose screen at the end of matches
[/list]


[u][b]ADDITIONS/CHANGES[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] The “defense” sword can now also hit the ball, with a smaller force and a slightly different angle than the "attack" sword. 
[*] Camera focus on ball activated by default
[*] Better display of best times on solo mode levels menu
[/list]


If you find a bug or think something should be done until the next version, let me know in the discord server :)

notes.title: Update following first feedback from early access testers
notes.notes:
[u][b]Various bug fixes : [/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Single-player level completion score incorrectly displayed in main menu
[*] Sub-menu offset problem making it difficult to read the latest tabs
[*] Keys to open lootboxes were not correctly assigned (3 free keys were added to everyone  to make up for the inconvenience)
[/list]

[u][b]Adjustments : [/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Smoother camera control with mouse, increased sensitivity
[*] Removed "drifiting", which slowed down too much on abrupt changes of direction
[*] Solo level 1 made less difficult, and minimum time to get 1 star increased. 
[/list]
